verdict: Inspected collaborator statements match the paper rectangle lemma and Theorem global on A_m, singular covariances included. Existing trust-0 logs report only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. This review did not rebuild.

coverage.GlobalFoundationBridge: Qualitative decodingSuccess and MGF comparison for IsCorrelation, singular Grams included. Does not state the rectangle constant.
coverage.GlobalComparisonProduct: normalizedSelfConvolution_product_ge_one gives 1 ≤ integral of the product for centered tilted half-lines on every IsCorrelation, singular included.
coverage.GlobalWitnessOrthantBound: orthant_mass_eq_tilted_product allows PosSemidef given AdaptiveWitnesses. exp_adaptive_value_le_orthant_of_ne_one requires IsWeakSimplexCov and R ≠ 1.
coverage.symmetricRectangle_gap: Paper rectangle coefficient times Frobenius sum of squares for PosSemidef unit-diagonal matrices, m ≥ 2, with an explicit singular pair endpoint.
coverage.quantitative_lowerOrthant: Paper Theorem global square-root and paperKappa forms for IsWeakSimplexCov, m ≥ 2, c in [u, v], singular included.
